body.p: After , . Owns tests/qt4/driver/assertion.c, report.c and, from now, the driver's CMakeLists.txt. Every assertion except the serialization ones (reported "unsupported", failing); assert binds $result; a wrong error code passes and is reported. Counts per test set, text and --format=json. ctest qt4_slice fails on any slice failure. Done when 198/198 pass under debug and debug-gcc. Done 2026-10-17 (): sxml-qt4 run; 198/198 pass under debug, debug-gcc and wasm; ctest qt4/slice fails below the baseline in tests/qt4/slice-baseline.txt (198). Serialization assertions are not-run rather than failing; no --output (no file writer in the CLI).
